name: @pipeworx/mcp-swapi

tools.name: search_people
tools.description: Search Star Wars characters by name. Returns name, physical attributes, birth year, gender, and homeworld URL.

tools.name: get_planet
tools.description: Get a Star Wars planet by its numeric ID. Returns name, climate, terrain, population, and orbital data.

tools.name: get_starship
tools.description: Get a Star Wars starship by its numeric ID. Returns name, model, manufacturer, crew capacity, and hyperdrive rating.

id.description: Starship ID (e.g., 9 for the Death Star)

tools.name: get_film
tools.description: Get a Star Wars film by its numeric ID. Returns title, episode number, director, producer, release date, and opening crawl.

id.description: Film ID (e.g., 1 for A New Hope)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-swapi forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the swapi pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
